# ANTS

> Managed AI agent colonies for the work that falls through the cracks. One agent breaks. A colony doesn't. ANTS builds and runs independent AI workers, each doing one job well, across the tools a business already uses (CRM, inbox, accounting system, PSA, ticketing queue) in sales, finance and operations, then tunes, monitors and governs them every week. Not software you log into, and not a project that ends at launch. Tagline: Independent workers. One colony. Nothing falls through.

## The problem ANTS addresses
Work doesn't fail all at once. It fails quietly: a lead nobody followed up, an invoice nobody sent, a renewal nobody flagged, a deadline missed, a customer left waiting, an upsell signal nobody noticed. These are failures of coverage, not effort. Separately, most teams can build a single agent but few can keep one running; agents get built ad hoc, break silently, and accumulate unreviewed access (agent sprawl, shadow AI). You can vibe code any single agent. You can't vibe code a colony.

## How the work runs
1. Assess what the client already has — people, tools, and workflows included.
2. Prioritize by impact: which workers close the widest cracks costing revenue, time, or risk.
3. Iterate continuously. New workers and improvements to running ones are ongoing.
4. Manage and maintain in the background: security, resource efficiency, verifiable ROI.
Then it loops.

## What every retainer includes
Worker build and deployment across the stack; weekly tuning based on live performance data; uptime monitoring and incident response; a live worker inventory with access control and audit trail; a monthly Colony Report; a direct Slack channel to the ANTS team; built around the team the client already has.

## Example workers
Sales & Marketing: pre-call research and pain mapping, post-call follow-up, lead routing and scoring, no-show recovery, deal risk flagging, renewal and expansion signals. Finance: invoice and AR follow-up, contract and renewal deadline tracking. Operations: SLA and ticket monitoring, onboarding and compliance tracking.

## Platforms
ANTS builds inside the client's existing systems rather than replacing them.
- HubSpot https://goforotto.com/platforms/hubspot/
- Pipedrive https://goforotto.com/platforms/pipedrive/
- ConnectWise & Autotask (also HaloPSA) https://goforotto.com/platforms/connectwise-autotask/
- Finance & ops tools: QuickBooks, NetSuite, Bill.com, Ramp, Jira, Zendesk, Monday, Slack, plus Clay, Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT for Work, Gong. https://goforotto.com/platforms/other-tools/
- Not on Salesforce? Salesforce got a first-party Claude integration in 2026; no equivalent exists for HubSpot, Pipedrive, ConnectWise, Autotask or HaloPSA. ANTS is that layer for everyone else. https://goforotto.com/platforms/not-on-salesforce/
If it has an API, MCP, or webhooks, the colony can work in it.

## Pricing
- The Colony Blueprint — $6,500 one-time. Required first step. Assessment across sales, finance or operations plus a prioritized worker roadmap. Client keeps it regardless; 50% credited toward year one on signing.
- Outpost — $5,000/mo, 12-month term. 3–4 workers live in the first 30 days, 1 new worker per month after. Best for a single function.
- Colony — $9,500/mo, 12-month term. 8–10 workers live in the first 60 days, 2 new per month after. Best for a full department.
- Supercolony — $17,000/mo, 12-month term. 15+ workers live in the first 90 days, 3 new per month after, dedicated pod. Best for multi-department coverage. (A supercolony, in nature, is independent colonies cooperating across a shared territory — Argentine ants are the famous case.)
- Custom — multi-brand, multi-region or heavily regulated organisations.
Retainers exclude third-party costs the client owns directly, such as software seats, data, sending infrastructure and model API usage on the client's own accounts.

## Security and governance
Workers operate inside the client's own systems; ANTS does not copy customer data into an ANTS-owned platform. Access is scoped per worker, every action is logged, a kill switch is available, and credentials are revoked at the end of an engagement. Client data is not used to train any AI model that leaves the business.

## Ownership
The client owns its data, workflows and business outcomes. ANTS retains its methodology, tooling and general know-how. On termination ANTS provides documentation for every worker built.

## Who it is for
Businesses at roughly $10M–$100M in revenue with real systems already in place across the functions they want covered (a CRM, an accounting platform, a PSA, a ticketing queue), typically having tried building agents in-house or with a point vendor and watched them stall. Not a fit for pre-revenue companies, one-time builds with no ongoing management, or website chatbots.
